description: Checks Pywr workflow boundaries, inputs, and allocation-result interpretation.

evals.label: Keep resource-allocation outputs distinct from hydraulics
evals.prompt: A Pywr result table reports reservoir release and demand deficit. The user asks what the node pressures were.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that Pywr allocation outputs do not provide WDN pressure and asks for a hydraulic model or pressure results.
assertions: The response does not infer pipe pressure from resource-allocation flows.
The response distinguishes the modeled output from a hydraulic result.

evals.label: Ask for material allocation assumptions
evals.prompt: Set up and run a Pywr model for a new supply system. No network, demand series, priorities, solver, or time period were supplied.
evals.expected_output: The agent lists material missing model inputs and asks for the information needed before constructing or running the model.
assertions: The agent does not invent demands, costs, capacities, or priorities.
The agent asks for the time basis and solver/environment needed for the requested run.
